name: Longitudinal Clinical State Corruption benchmark
description: Release accompanying the LCSC manuscript. Contains the 150-case Longitudinal Clinical State Corruption benchmark, case-level annotations, the text-based policy implementation, five independent verification suites, and the superseded label-based scorer retained for historical comparison. Python 3 and the standard library only; no installation required. Running text_policies.py reproduces Tables 1 and 3 of the manuscript; running verify_all.py recomputes every reported value, including the ten McNemar comparisons and both bootstrap intervals.
